title: DuckTales Old
description: Duck TalesScrooge McDuck finds his hands full at home when nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie move to Duckburg. Joined by their loyal pals Launchpad McQuack, Gyro Gearloose and Mrs. Beakley, the DuckTales gang never fails to deliver a wealth of adventure. Get ready for a fortune of fun with DuckTales!

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x1
episodes_data.description: The introduction of the series, as Donald Duck joins the Navy and sends Huey, Dewey, and Louie off to live with their uncle Scrooge McDuck. Meanwhile, a mysterious man named El Capitán busts the Beagle Boys out of jail in order for them to help him steal an awkward treasure map in Scrooge's possession.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x2
episodes_data.description: After foiling the Beagle Boys, Scrooge and his nephews decipher the strange marking on the map, which leads to a sunken treasure ship in Ronguay. However, Flintheart Glomgold and El Capitán are out to stop them at every turn.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x3
episodes_data.description: Upon finding out of the Valley of the Golden Suns, Scrooge begins an expedition to find the treasure therein, starting with finding the map that leads to it. First, he must get one half of the map from High Golden Sun Priest Joaquin Slowly.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x4
episodes_data.description: The nephews, Webby, and Mrs. Beakley find themselves joining Scrooge in his adventure as he looks for the second half of the treasure map in Antarctica.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x5
episodes_data.description: Scrooge develops gold fever as he and the gang make their way to the Valley of the Golden Suns, all the while pursued by El Capitán.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x6
episodes_data.description: Magica DeSpell gets the Beagle Boys to help her steal the Number One Dime, disguising them as the nephews.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x7
episodes_data.description: An ancient Egyptian civilization abducts Donald so that he can host a spirit of a Pharaoh.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x8
episodes_data.description: Gyro's props for a science fiction television show accidentally launch the cast into space, and Launchpad becomes the hero when it is realized that he is the only real pilot on board.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x9
episodes_data.description: Gyro presents the McDuck household with a robot named Armstrong to do their work for them. However, the robot decides it would rather work for itself.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x10
episodes_data.description: After the incident with Armstrong, Gyro builds giant human-operated robots for Glomgold, only to have them be stolen and operated by Ma Beagle and the Beagle Boys.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x11
episodes_data.description: Magica's plot to steal the Number One Dime using her own shadow goes awry when her shadow develops a mind of its own.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x12
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and Glomgold race for mastership of Aladdin's genie.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x13
episodes_data.description: Scrooge turns a castle once owned by mad scientist into a hotel, but he doesn't believe that the place is haunted.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x14
episodes_data.description: Scrooge goes searching for a crown in the Himalayas, which is guarded by a snow beast. Loosely based on the Carl Barks story of the same name.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x15
episodes_data.description: Scrooge is framed for stealing a painting from Glomgold's art gallery and sent to Aquatraz.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x16
episodes_data.description: The Beagle Boys steal Gyro's handheld teleporter and use it to steal Scrooge's fortune.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x17
episodes_data.description: Gyro, tired of being looked upon as a "gadget man", invents a time machine and uses it to go back in time to the Middle Ages.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x18
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and Launchpad explore a land where dinosaurs still live, but the kids tag along against Scrooge's directions to the contrary.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x19
episodes_data.description: After being fired by Scrooge, Launchpad is tricked by the Beagle Boys into performing a series of bank robberies disguised as movie scenes.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x20
episodes_data.description: Having a hard time at camp, Doofus accidentally finds a stolen alien crystal that grants him numerous super powers.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x21
episodes_data.description: Mrs. Beakley is abducted by Vikings and it is up to Scrooge and the others to rescue her.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x22
episodes_data.description: A family debt causes Scrooge to lose his entire fortune, sending his entire family into the poorhouse.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x23
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and the boys track down a lost play by a famed playwright.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x24
episodes_data.description: Launchpad's family comes to visit while the Beagle Boys eye Scrooge's new jet so that they can use it to pilfer his Money Bin.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x25
episodes_data.description: Scrooge learns that a pearl he bought will grant him infinite wisdom once he takes it back to its homeland.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x26
episodes_data.description: Scrooge, the nephews, and Webby visit Scrooge's ancestral home in Scotland, only to be embroiled in a mystery surrounding Castle McDuck.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x27
episodes_data.description: When going to Virginia for a Civil War reenactment, Launchpad encounters aged Confederate veterans who once served under his ancestor, who had lost a battle. Meanwhile, Doofus and the nephews learn that a businessman is exploiting the reenactments for financial gain. Launchpad works to avenge his family's honor by rallying the old veterans to a "rematch" of sorts against the reenactors.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x28
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and the boys head for Florida in search of the fabled Fountain of Youth.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x29
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and the boys discover that the games of an underground civilization are causing earthquakes directly under the Money Bin.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x30
episodes_data.description: Circe, a sorceress from the past transports Scrooge and the boys back to time of Ancient Greece, where they meet up with Homer.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x31
episodes_data.description: Scrooge seeks to find out why his ships are disappearing in the Bermuda Triangle.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x32
episodes_data.description: Scrooge misuses an alien size-shifting device, and accidentally ends up shrinking himself, the boys, and Webby.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x33
episodes_data.description: Scrooge takes the kids to the Klondike, where he met an old flame, Glittering Goldie.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x34
episodes_data.description: Webby helps trains a horse for the Kenducky Derby so the owner will have the money to raise it.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x35
episodes_data.description: Scrooge loses the new combination for his vault to a lemming.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x36
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and Glomgold compete in a contest where the winner, being the world's richest duck, becomes the sales broker for a new fruit from Macaroon that works like a flashlight. First, though, Scrooge must keep his fortune away from the Beagle Boys.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x37
episodes_data.description: As Scrooge tries to deliver his fortune to Macaroon, he experiences an interference in the form of a rogue submarine working for Glomgold.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x38
episodes_data.description: After dumping his fortune under the sea, Scrooge, along with Launchpad, Gyro, and Doofus, submerges in order to get it out.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x39
episodes_data.description: Glomgold and the Beagle Boys attempt to make sure Scrooge doesn't win the contest on his way to Macaroon.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x40
episodes_data.description: The Nephews, Webby, and Doofus attempt to earn a Junior Woodchuck badge in sailing while a sea monster is preying on Scrooge's shipping fleet.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x41
episodes_data.description: After hearing about Launchpad's encounter with several Harpies, Scrooge heads to the Black Sea to seek out the legendary Golden Fleece.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x42
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and the boys go to Scrooge's oil wells to find out why they ran dry.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x43
episodes_data.description: Gyro invents a watch that allows anyone to move super fast. But the Beagle Boys want to use it so they can steal all of Scrooge's money.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x44
episodes_data.description: Something's attacking Scrooge's sheep and shearing off their wool, so Scrooge heads off for Australia to find out what's going on.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x45
episodes_data.description: Scrooge acquires a magical harp that can determine if someone was lying or not. However, Magica de Spell wants the harp for herself, and so does the harp's guardian.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x46
episodes_data.description: After being fired by Scrooge, Launchpad enters the space program, and accidentally gets sent to Mars.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x47
episodes_data.description: While experiencing a fever, Scrooge has an extended dream sequence parodying the fairy tale of Cinderella, with himself in the titular role.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x48
episodes_data.description: Launchpad finds himself masquerading as Bruno Von Beak, an agent for the Foreign Organization of World Larceny.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x49
episodes_data.description: After finding a leprechaun, Scrooge is led to Ireland, where he believes that he'll find a vast fortune of gold.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x50
episodes_data.description: After being fired by Scrooge, Duckworth and the boys are abducted by plant aliens and enslaved.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x51
episodes_data.description: Magica uses a pair of magic mirrors to try to get Scrooge's Number One Dime.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x52
episodes_data.description: Duckworth coaches the Junior Woodchucks in a baseball game.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x53
episodes_data.description: Magica sends Scrooge into the future, where she has stolen his Number One Dime and taken over his company.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x54
episodes_data.description: While accompanying Scrooge in his search for silver, Mrs. Beakley encounters a Tarzan-like character who used to be a boy she helped raise as a nanny.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x55
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and Launchpad reminisce on how they first met.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x56
episodes_data.description: Magica tricks Gladstone Gander into stealing the Number One Dime for her, and as a result, he is then cursed with bad luck.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x57
episodes_data.description: Scrooge and the boys take a trip to visit an old friend of his, Count Roy. However, unknown to Scrooge, Roy's evil twin Ray rules Roy's kingdom with an iron fist.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x58
episodes_data.description: Scrooge makes a bet with Glomgold that he can make money off a blimp called the Hindentanic.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x59
episodes_data.description: Seeking respect from other members of Duckburg's elite, Scrooge hunts down a mask he gave away

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x60
episodes_data.description: Scrooge, the nephews, Doofus, and Duckworth are intimidated by a cloud that generates their worst fears, conjured by Magica.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x61
episodes_data.description: Scrooge becomes a victim of a potion that causes him to be obsessive with giving money away. It is up to his nephews to find an antidote before he stays a big spender forever.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 1x62
episodes_data.description: Scrooge tells the story of how his Number One Dime got his fortune started.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x1
episodes_data.description: Scrooge buys one of Glomgold's islands, wherein houses a diamond mine. Upon finding out, Glomgold has the diamond mine blown away from the island. Scrooge, Launchpad, and the nephews then go back in time to try to prevent the explosion, but end up going 1 million years back, where they meet Bubba the Caveduck and his pet Triceratops, Tootsie.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x2
episodes_data.description: In their attempt to go back to the present, Scrooge, Launchpad, the nephews, and Bubba & Tootsie crash-land in an ancient kingdom terrorized by a tyrant.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x3
episodes_data.description: Upon their return to the present, Scrooge blames all his financial troubles on Bubba, all the while the Beagle Boys try to capture him.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x4
episodes_data.description: After the Beagle Boys kick them out of the Money Bin, Scrooge and Bubba have a series of troubles that land them in jail.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x5
episodes_data.description: As Scrooge, the nephews, and Launchpad try to find a way to pay Glomgold for the aforementioned island, Bubba & Tootsie, having now returned to the past, feel lonely and try to return to the present.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x6
episodes_data.description: In order to move his Money Bin after the Beagle Boys change the new freeway route, Scrooge hires an accountant, and Fenton Crackshell gets the job.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x7
episodes_data.description: After accidentally losing the Number One Dime to the Beagle Boys, Fenton makes several attempts to get it back, eventually becoming the cybernetic superhero GizmoDuck.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x8
episodes_data.description: GizmoDuck becomes a sensation with the people of Duckburg - that is, until Ma Beagle and her smartest son, Megabyte Beagle, make a remote control with which to make him work for them.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x9
episodes_data.description: After the Beagles get GizmoDuck to steal Scrooge's fortune for them and land Scrooge in jail, the nephews work to save the day.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 2x10
episodes_data.description: Alien robots invade and steal Scrooge's Money Bin so that it can be melted down to produce more metal.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x1
episodes_data.description: When Scrooge develops an unnatural ailment, Fenton takes him to a place where money isn't used. But Fenton's plan backfires when he gets the locals to use bottlecaps as currency.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x2
episodes_data.description: In order to receive their allowances ahead of time so they can buy a new scooter, the nephews trick Scrooge into believing it's Saturday instead of Friday, resulting in mass confusion worldwide.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x3
episodes_data.description: In this spoof of Romeo and Juliet, Bubba falls in love with the daughter of Scrooge's new neighbors, who have gotten in a feud with Scrooge.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x4
episodes_data.description: The Beagle Babes, female cousins of the Beagle Boys, kidnap Webby in ransom for a set of crown jewels.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x5
episodes_data.description: Fenton's mother suffers a bad shock when trying to get better television reception. Her new-found psychic abilities are soon exploited by Scrooge, much to Fenton's chagrin.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x6
episodes_data.description: A robot maid built by Gyro falls in love with GizmoDuck.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x7
episodes_data.description: Inflation shoots up the roof when duplicating coins spread through Duckburg.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x8
episodes_data.description: Bubba's grades are deplorable, so the nephews use one of Gyro's latest inventions to increase his IQ, but they all soon become annoyed with the new Bubba.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x9
episodes_data.description: Fenton shoots a series of test commercials, but mistakingly creates demand for a nonexistant product. In desperation, he uses a new bubble gum invented by Gyro, who has not had time to test for side effects.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x10
episodes_data.description: Scrooge's nephews are trying to figure out just who Gizmoduck's secret identity is. So far, their predictions all point to Launchpad McQuack.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x11
episodes_data.description: Scrooge suffers a case of amnesia, during which he protests against himself and dates Fenton's mother.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x12
episodes_data.description: The Beagle Boys become the latest music sensation in Duckburg, much to Scrooge's chagrin.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x13
episodes_data.description: The nephews makes business decisions in Scrooge's name while Scrooge is in the hospital.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x14
episodes_data.description: Ma Beagle pretends that she's married to Scrooge in order to inherit his fortune.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x15
episodes_data.description: Scrooge acquires a special glass from Gyro that makes the Money Bin invulnerable to attack.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x16
episodes_data.description: Webby, who has been feeling overlooked, ends up becoming a giantess after falling into a mysterious pool in the jungle. While she is now the center of attention, she does not like it very much. While Scrooge searches for a way to reverse the process, a corrupt circus owner seeks to kidnap Webby for his new sideshow.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x17
episodes_data.description: Scrooge decides to become a vigilante after an unflattering report on him on television.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 3x18
episodes_data.description: Scrooge acquires magical love arrows that once belonged to a goddess.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 4x1
episodes_data.description: Scrooge meets up with Glittering Goldie again in order to acquire land filled with golden trees from her. However, Glomgold also wants that land.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 4x2
episodes_data.description: Glomgold intends to use metal-eating bugs to wipe out Scrooge's fortunes.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 4x3
episodes_data.description: Fenton uncovers an international conspiracy to steal Scrooge's gold overseas while supposedly on vacation.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 4x4
episodes_data.description: Fenton's mother accidentally shrinks the Gizmoduck suit, and the child-size suit ends up in the hands of Scrooge's nephews.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 4x5
episodes_data.description: When Scrooge loses his money due to a computer bug, he and Fenton travel through cyberspace to get it back.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 4x6
episodes_data.description: Dijon ends up joining the Brotherhood of the Goose, a group dedicated to protecting the Golden Goose (a goose that can turn anything to gold), led by his brother Poupon. Dijon "borrows" it, but accidentally loses it to Scrooge, who soon discovers its secret but then loses it to the Beagle Boys, whom Glomgold has sent to get it.

episodes_data.title: DuckTales Old 4x7
episodes_data.description: Scrooge, Launchpad, Dijon, and Poupon try to retrieve the Golden Goose from Glomgold and the Beagles before it can set off its transformations that can bring forth the end of the world.
